summary: Brixmor Operating Partnership LP filed an 8-K to report the completion of a $400M offering of 5.375% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes were issued under a Sixteenth Supplemental Indenture, are unsecured and unsubordinated, and rank equally with existing debt. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including potential repayment of outstanding 4.125% Senior Notes due 2026. The notes mature June 15, 2036, with semi-annual interest payments. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation event.
